title: Rearrange String K Distance Apart
statement:
Given a string S and an integer K, rearrange the characters of S such that the same characters are at least K distance apart.

If it is possible, print any valid rearrangement. If impossible, print "IMPOSSIBLE".

When K = 0, any arrangement is valid.

Note: a valid output is accepted as long as no two identical characters are within K positions of each other and the character multiset matches the original.
inputFormat:
The first line contains the string S.
The second line contains K.
constraints:
1 <= |S| <= 500
0 <= K <= |S|
S contains only lowercase English letters.

examples.explanation: Each character is 3 positions apart from its next occurrence.
'a' appears 3 times, |S|=5. We cannot space 3 a's with K=3 gap.

starterCode.python:
s = input().strip()
k = int(input())
# Write your solution here
# Hint: max-heap by freq; use a queue of size k as cooldown
